snippet.title: Official Boomlings Trailer
snippet.description:
Can you handle The Boom?

Boomlings is an addictive puzzle game with crazy characters, hand-drawn 2D animation, challenging gameplay, Online leaderboards, achievements, rewards, and much much more! Prepare for a unique puzzle matching experience like you've never seen before!

Google Play: http://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.robtopx.boomlings

App Store: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/boomlings/id504386925?ls=1&mt=8
